title: Stability of equilibria of an aggregation-diffusion energy on sphere
summary: We consider an aggregation-diffusion energy on the sphere and investigate the stability of its equilibria. The energy consists of a porous-medium type nonlinear entropy $\frac{1}{m-1}\int ρ(x)^m\mathrm{d}S(x)$ with $m>1$, together with an interaction energy modeled by a quadratic interaction potential. The energy generalizes the Onsager free energy with dipolar potential, which models polymer orientation.
